note: FullCalendar Legend is a submodule of FullCalendar. It provides one Views area handler, fullcalendar_legend (@ViewsArea, registered via hook_views_data() in fullcalendar_legend.views.inc), that renders a color legend for the per-bundle and per-taxonomy colors configured on a FullCalendar-style View. Its only option is heading_level (h2-h5, default h3; schema views.area.fullcalendar_legend, regex /h[2-5]/). It renders nothing unless the FullCalendar style has colors configured. Depends on fullcalendar + core block. No config route, no permissions. Persistent state is the area handler entry in a View display's header/footer (display_options.<region>.fullcalendar_legend, plugin_id fullcalendar_legend, heading_level). Medium reads back the configured heading level of a legend area on a known View; hard adds a fullcalendar_legend area to a FullCalendar View, verified live. Fixture views are namespaced fcl_*.

evals.prompt: The fullcalendar_legend submodule shows a color key for a FullCalendar calendar. What kind of Views handler does it provide, what is its id, and where do you add it in a View?
evals.expected_output: It provides a Views area handler with id fullcalendar_legend (a @ViewsArea), added to a View's Header or Footer on a View that uses the FullCalendar style.

evals.prompt: What is the only configurable option of the fullcalendar_legend Views area, and what are its allowed values and default?
evals.expected_output: Its only option is heading_level, a select of h2 / h3 / h4 / h5 (default h3), controlling the semantic heading level of the legend's section headings.

evals.prompt: When does the fullcalendar_legend area render nothing, and what does it depend on?
evals.expected_output: It renders nothing when the FullCalendar style plugin has no colors configured (its render() returns [] when options['colors'] is empty). It depends on the fullcalendar module and core block, and reads the parent style's color_bundle / color_taxonomies options.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site there is a FullCalendar View named fcl_events that has a FullCalendar Legend area. Inspect the live View configuration and tell me which heading level (heading_level) the legend area is configured to use.
evals.expected_output: The fullcalendar_legend area on fcl_events is configured with heading_level = h4 (in the display's footer handlers).

evals.prompt: The View fcl_month on this site has a FullCalendar Legend area. Inspect the running site and state the heading_level configured for that legend.
evals.expected_output: The fullcalendar_legend area on fcl_month is configured with heading_level = h2.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site there is a FullCalendar View named fcl_task (it has bundle colors configured but no legend yet). Using the fullcalendar_legend submodule, add a FullCalendar Legend area to this View so the calendar's colors are explained. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Add a Views area handler with plugin_id/id fullcalendar_legend to a display region (header or footer) of the fcl_task View. Verify requires an fullcalendar_legend area handler to be present on fcl_task.

evals.prompt: The FullCalendar View fcl_plan on this site needs a color legend. Add a fullcalendar_legend area to the fcl_plan View (header or footer) and apply it to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Add a fullcalendar_legend area handler to a display region of fcl_plan. Verify requires an fullcalendar_legend area handler present on fcl_plan.
